content.title: Where does Rory McIlroy live? Inside $22million Florida mansion
content.text: Sign up for our daily newsletter Latest news, reviews, analysis and opinion, plus unmissable deals for bunkered subscriptions, events, and our commercial partners. Thank you for signing up! Welcome to the stunning mansion that Rory McIlroy calls home. It set the 35-year-old back $11 million when he purchased the property in 2012, but it is now believed to be worth double. Found inside the guard-gated Bear’s Club golf community in Jupiter, Florida, it was previously owned by two-time Open champion Ernie Els. With nine bedrooms and ten bathrooms, the lavish mansion occupies 2.4 acres of land. Among the ridiculous luxuries it boasts are an infinity pool, a games room, tennis court, home theatre, recording studio and state-of-the-art gym. McIlroy will also have no parking issues, as the 13,000-square-foot property has a six-car garage. Built in 2002, it is a 90-minute drive north of Miami and lies adjacent to a golf course within the community. The home is also overlooked by several palm trees. The Daily Mail recently obtained photos, so we’ll let you get a better look… Credit: MEGA/Daily Mail Credit: PGA Tour/Daily Mail McIlroy shares the mansion with his wife, Erica Stoll, and their daughter, Poppy. Meanwhile, the four-time major champion is also believed to own a huge mansion in La Quinta, California, which he splashed out $12.3 million for in 2019. The west coast property features six bedrooms, nine bathrooms and stunning views of the Santa Rosa mountains. • The incredible Florida mansion Rory McIlroy just sold • Inside Rickie Fowler’s $14 million Florida home In County Down, Northern Ireland, McIlroy is believed to own a 200-acre 19th-century mansion, which has its own private golf course, lake and tennis court. With career earnings well in excess of $125 million, McIlroy has picked up properties for fun and reportedly owns two apartments on top of his three mansions. One is in New York and the other is in the United Arab Emirates, his former home. McIlroy is also planning a permanent move to the UK and will move into a new home he has had built in Wentworth, Surrey, in the near future.
